blocks.text: Nucleic acids bare biomolecules hain jo jeneyati maloomat jama aur muntaqil karte hain. Yeh nucleotides kehlane wale chhote units ke polymers hain. Har nucleic acid zanjeer mein baari baari shakar aur phosphate groups hote hain, aur har shakar se aik organic (nitrogen wala) base jura hota hai. RNA mein shakar ribose aur DNA mein deoxyribose hai; dono paanch carbon wali shakar hain. Nucleotides shakar ke 5' aur 3' carbon atoms ke darmiyan phosphodiester linkages se jurte hain, aur yeh amal kai million baar dohra kar polynucleotide banta hai. Phosphodiester linkages mazboot covalent bonds hain, jo zanjeer ko mazbooti aur istehkaam dete hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: do nucleotides. 5' sire par phosphate aik paanch rukni shakar ring ke 5' CH2 se jura hai jis par BASE hai; shakar ka 3' carbon O ke zariye doosre phosphate, phosphodiester linkage, se jura hai jo agli shakar aur base ke 5' CH2 se judta hai; woh shakar 3' OH par khatam hoti hai, zanjeer ka 3' sira. Daen: zanjeer bari bari phosphate aur shakar, har shakar par base.

blocks.text: 5' aur 3' carbon ke number shakar ke hain. Aik nucleotide ke 3' carbon ki oxygen phosphate ke zariye agle nucleotide ke 5' CH2 se judti hai; yeh phosphodiester linkage hai. Kitab ne jorne wale phosphate mein 3' carbon se aane wali oxygen ko P se double bond (P=O) se dikhaya; asal mein yeh oxygen P se single bond se judti hai aur double bond aik alag (bahar wali) oxygen par hota hai. Khaake mein sahi shakal dikhayi gayi hai.

blocks.prompt: Nucleotide kin teen hisson se banta hai?
blocks.explanation: Phosphate group, paanch carbon wali shakar (ribose ya deoxyribose) aur nitrogen wala base.

items: Nucleic acids: nucleotides (phosphate + shakar + base) ke polymers.
Shakar-phosphate reerh phosphodiester links (5' se 3') se jori.
